subject: Hosting path options + PoC success metrics (hybrid/VPC recommendation)
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medicore.ai>, Oliver Park <oliver.park@medicore.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosting path options + PoC success metrics (hybrid/VPC recommendation)

Hi Emma / Oliver — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we draft the formal PoC SOW: 

Key constraints you shared:
- PHI will not leave your Azure tenant; all customer data must stay in a VPC/Private deployment.
- SOC 2 + encryption at rest + key control via your Azure Key Vault required.
- Target: evaluate latency + semantic recall on 4 representative workflows within 6 weeks.

Hosting options we discussed (short):
1) Hosted Redwood API (fastest to start) — not acceptable because data residency requirement.
2) Dedicated sandbox (Redwood-managed infra in our cloud but isolated) — can be configured with stricter retention and can be deployed in a customer-specific subscription, but still involves data transfer outside your tenant.
3) Private VPC deployment (recommended) — deploy Redwood Private control plane with model serving inside your VPC or on-prem. Meets your data residency/KMS requirements.

My recommendation based on constraints: proceed with a scoped Private VPC PoC (short-lived, single model variant) to validate latency and functional metrics, plus a fallback Dedicated sandbox for any non-PHI synthetic testing.

Proposed success criteria (draft — attached as spreadsheet):
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/min with p95 latency < 300ms for 512-token requests on the chosen model profile.
- Quality: average task-level F1 >= 0.82 on the evaluation set you provided (5 prompts per workflow).
- Cost signaling: 95% of calls under $0.015/token for our recommended quantized model path (tracking in PoC dashboard).
- Security: deployed in your VPC with KMS keys, SOC 2 evidence checklist completed by week 4.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- Emma: confirm we can proceed with a VPC deployment and share the network contact + preferred region (Azure eastus2) by Oct 20.
- Redwood (Ben / Karthik): provide a one-page VPC runbook and a high-level estimate for a 6-week PoC by Oct 20.
- Hannah / Marissa: draft PoC SOW and schedule kickoff for week of Oct 26 if greenlit.

Attachments: PoC_Success_Criteria_v2.xlsx; hosting-options-cost-comparison.pdf; Medicore-data-flow-diagram.png

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosting path options + PoC success metrics (hybrid/VPC recommendation)

Thanks Hannah — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Confirmed: PHI must remain in our tenant. We can provision a delegated subnet for a vendor-managed service if the vendor supports customer-managed keys (CMK).
- SOC 2 evidence is required but we have a 3rd-party security review window that would need documentation by week 3 of the PoC.
- Timeline is tight: procurement can sign a short PoC contract within 7 business days after we agree on scope, but networking/setup can take a week to provision.

Action: I'll introduce you to our cloud infra lead (Oliver) in this thread — he'll handle the VNet peering, firewall rules, and KMS pairing details.

On success criteria, the quality thresholds look good but can we relax throughput to 30 req/min initial and scale if needed? We want to focus on correctness and secure deployment first.

Emma Jones
Head of Product, Medicore Health
emma.jones@medicore.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medicore.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosting path options + PoC success metrics (hybrid/VPC recommendation)

Emma — appreciate the clarifications. Two quick notes from infra/cost side: 
- We can run a Private VPC deployment into your Azure tenant using an Azure Marketplace image + our orchestrator. This supports your CMK requirement (we integrate with Azure Key Vault).
- Initial footprint for a 6-week PoC (1 model shard + 2 gpus for redundancy) estimate: ~$18k - $24k depending on reserved vs burst capacity. I'll surface a written estimate and variation table in the VPC runbook.

On throughput: agreed — start at 30 req/min p95 target of 350ms, and we can iterate up if you have peak windows.

I'll attach the hosting runbook and cost breakdown doc in the next email (short form).

—Ben

Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
